description: Delete an appointment from a given month.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to delete.

month.description: Month containing the appointment, as a number from 1 to 12.

notify.description: When true, notify attendees about the deletion.

occurrence_day.description: Optional day of the occurrence to delete, for a repeating appointment.

scope.description: Optional scope of the deletion for a repeating appointment, such as a single occurrence or the series.

year.description: Year of the month containing the appointment.

name: delete_appointment
